system.description: Base Essence (Elemental Companion) 5.14.6 - Lesser Elemental Protections. Resisting the caster's own Main Element, one element of his Triad, or any element at all, with escalating DB and RR bonuses (Resist/Armor I-II, Prismatic), draining incoming elemental damage and critical severity (Main/Triad/Elemental Sink I-II), and ultimately outright immunity to Main/Triad/any elemental attacks. Fidelity notes: levels 10, 11, and 18 are intentionally blank in the source (no spell printed); levels 19 (Elemental Sink II) and 20 (Main Sink True) have no description printed at all - the source's own numbered description list jumps straight from 17 to 25 - so their description fields here simply note that gap rather than inventing text; level 19 also references a base "Elemental Sink I" that itself never appears anywhere on this list, only Main Sink I/II and Triad Sink I/II do.

Caster is protected from all natural forms of caster's main element; additionally target gets +10 to Resistance Rolls (RR's) against the caster's main element; and elemental attacks from the caster's main element are at -20. These bonuses apply to Magical, High, and True Elemental Material. This spell only works against attacks from the caster's Main element (Fire, for a Fire Champion; Ice, for an Ice Champion, etc.).
As Resist Main, except it is effective against one of the elements from the caster's triad. This must be chosen at the time of casting.
As Resist Triad, except caster may choose any single element.

Elemental power is drained from elemental attacks of the caster's primary element, halving the damage delivered by the attack and reducing the Critical Severity by one. This will affect all attacks from the caster's main element that will strike the caster the round this spell is cast.
As Resist Main, except bonus is +20.
As Resist Triad, except bonus is +20.
As Resist Main, except it affects all of the elements from the caster's triad.
As Main Sink I, except it will work against any element from the caster's triad.
As Resist Element, except bonus is +20.

As Main Armor I, except it also decreases concussion hit damage from the caster's Main element by half, and decreases critical strikes by one level (e.g. 'A's become an 'A'-25, 'B's become 'A's, 'C's become 'B's, etc.)
As Main Sink I, except damage is quartered and critical severities are reduced by two.
As Main Armor II except it affects any one element in the caster's triad, element affected is chosen at time of casting.
As Main Armor I, except it works against all three elements of the caster's triad.
As Main Sink II, except it will work against any element of the caster's triad.
As Main Armor II, except it affects any one element; element affected is chosen at time of casting.
[No description printed in the source - its numbered description list skips directly from 17 to 25.]
[No description printed in the source - its numbered description list skips directly from 17 to 25.]
Target is made completely immune to elemental attacks from the caster's Main Element.
As Main Immunity, except it works against any one element from the caster's triad. Element must be chosen at the time of casting.
As Triad Immunity, except any element may be chosen.
